fusions.name: Stoop From On High
fusions.desc: Dives on a target up to 8 tiles away. The dive deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Wheeling Buffet
fusions.desc: A gust around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: On the Wing
fusions.desc: Carries you instantly to a spot up to 7 tiles away, and your dodge chance rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Riding the Thermal
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover restores 6 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
